newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation stable at 0.2 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation stable at 0.2 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have remained stable in the week ended May 12 at 0.2 percent, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
If current price trends continue, monthly inflation for the whole of May will be 0.9 percent, the committee said. The monthly inflation rate in April was 1.0 percent.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended May 12 May 5
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.3 +0.4
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.044 +0.042
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data, but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
